title: Accept stop-and-measure surveying as the final mission
summary: James confirmed the final mission is surveying an operator-drawn region and that stopping at measurement locations satisfies it. Deck stability is required during acquisition; moving acquisition is optional. Measurement quality remains to be defined. This is a requirements decision, not a capability acceptance or a research restart.
next: Discuss the first required survey measurement and its quality with James and the payload owner, one decision at a time.
